# MM-P2-L3-IH03 - Maintenance manual - Machining induction billet heater #3

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-IH03

Scope
- This manual covers preventive and corrective maintenance tasks required for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) installed in P2-L3.
- Intended for qualified maintenance technicians and engineers responsible for heater mechanical, electrical, and cooling subsystems.
- Reference related procedures and quality requirements: MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3, QS-PROC-10, SOP-P2-L3-02.

Tools
- Insulated hand tools rated for the plant electrical policy.
- Thermal contact pyrometer or calibrated thermocouple capable of reading the target billet temperature.
- Flow meter compatible with the coil cooling water circuit.
- Personal protective equipment as specified in SOP-P2-L3-02.

Procedure
- Isolate power and verify lockout/tagout per plant practice before accessing the heater assembly; follow electrical isolation in SOP-P2-L3-02.
- Inspect coil and refractory visually for cracks, deformation, or loose fittings. Replace or report per MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3.
- Verify coil cooling water flow using the flow meter at the pump discharge or coil inlet. Confirm the coil cooling water flow minimum for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 72 L/min. If flow is below this value, investigate strainers, valves, and pump performance; do not operate the heater until flow meets the specified minimum.
- With safe access and protective equipment, perform a heat-up verification on a test billet or instrumented surrogate. Confirm the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03) is 1175 °C during process verification. If the target is not achieved, follow diagnostic steps in MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3.
- Reassemble covers and restore power following SOP-P2-L3-02. Record all findings and corrective actions in maintenance log per QS-PROC-10.

Acceptance criteria
- No visible damage or loose components on coil and refractory documented.
- Coil cooling water flow meets or exceeds 72 L/min.
- Heater achieves and maintains 1175 °C on verification billet within process control limits.
- All maintenance actions logged and referenced per MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3 and QS-PROC-10.
